items.briefing:
Scammers are becoming increasingly sophisticated, with AI now helping criminal groups run more convincing fraud campaigns at scale. Australians should be particularly alert to gambling and betting scams currently flagged by Scamwatch, as well as phishing emails impersonating RingCentral that attempt to steal Microsoft 365 login credentials — a tool widely used across Australian workplaces.

If you receive an unexpected email asking you to sign into Microsoft 365, stop and verify it through official channels before clicking anything.

featured.title: SAS Innovate: New era of scams requires novel solutions
featured.quote: Australians losing billions to AI-driven fraud demands urgent industry collaboration on scam solutions.
